FAQ

Minimum Age

The minimum age for visitors to the Toffler Festival is 18 years. This will be checked at the entrance, and if there is any doubt, you may be asked to show valid identification. If you are unable to provide this, you may be denied entry to the event, even if you have purchased a festival ticket. In such cases, the organization will not refund the cost of the ticket.

Location

Weena-Zuid 33 | 3012 NH | Rotterdam. A 5 minute walk from Rotterdam Central Station.

Opening times

Doors open at 23:00 till 05:00. Please always check the event opening times.

Tickets

Tickets can be purchased online via our ticketshop. If the event is not sold out, tickets will also be available at the entrance. This will be clearly communicated in advance via the website and social media. There is no need to print your ticket(s); they can be scanned from a mobile phone. If using a phone, make sure your ticket is ready and your screen brightness is set to maximum.

No phone policy

Cameras will be covered at the entrance and taking photos or videos is not allowed. When moments are constantly captured, the atmosphere changes. Our goal is to create a safe and intimate environment where everyone can express themselves freely, without feeling watched or recorded. Some moments are meant to be felt, not filmed. Be present. Respect the space. Enjoy the moment.

Phone use is permitted; recording images or video may result in immediate removal from the venue.

Lockers

Toffler uses lockers. Lockers are available. Open with a locker token. Reopening costs €2. You can use another token or a €2 coin.

Parking

There is no direct street parking available in front of the club. However, around the corner you will find Q-Park Weena, which is the nearest parking facility.

By public transport

Plan your journey to Weena-Zuid 33, Rotterdam via 9292OV.

Smoking & Vaping

Smoking/vaping is not allowed in Toffler. Smoking is permitted only in the designated smoking area.

Food & Drinks

Bringing your own food or drinks to the club is not allowed.

Medication

Bringing medication is allowed, provided you can show an official doctor’s note and that the medication is kept in its original packaging.

Hearing(Damage)

Hearing damage can easily occur when you spend a long time in a loud environment. At Toffler sound levels can exceed 95 dB. It is therefore highly recommended to wear hearing protection and to give your ears regular breaks. Earplugs will be available on-site at the entrance.

Lost & Found

For any lost items, you can contact the organization by sending an email to info@toffler.nl

If our response is delayed, please note that our office is not located at the same place as the club, and we therefore require some time to search for the lost and found items.

Tickets FAQ

I’ve lost my ticket(s), where can I find them?

If you can’t find your ticket(s) or have lost the confirmation email with your ticket(s), you can request the confirmation email to be resent via this link

I entered my email address incorrectly, how can I change it?

If you still can’t find your tickets in your inbox after requesting them, you can update your email address using the payment reference from your bank statement. You can change your details via this link

How do I personalise my tickets?

Every visitor of Toffler Festival must personalise their tickets. Entry to the festival is only possible with a ticket in your own name. After purchasing the tickets, the main buyer will receive an email with instructions to personalise the tickets.

To personalise your ticket(s), follow the instructions below:

1. Click the link in the confirmation email to start the personalization process.

2. Claim one of your tickets for yourself by selecting “Claim ticket” and entering your personal details.

How can your friends personalise their tickets?

1. Send one or more tickets to a friend by selecting “Send to friend”.

2. Your friend will receive an invitation via email at the provided address, which they can accept by selecting “Claim now”

3. Your friend claims their ticket.

4. They will be redirected to the personalisation page where they can enter their details.

Why do I need to personalise my tickets?

All popular events face organizations and individuals reselling purchased tickets at inflated prices. To prevent this, we ask the ticket buyer to personalize the tickets by entering the details of the person who will attend the event. This helps reduce the chance of large quantities of tickets being resold at excessive prices. Additionally, it allows us to better inform government authorities in case of emergencies.

Ticket personalisation takes place after you have completed your order.

What is the deadline to personalise my tickets?

Tickets do not need to be personalized immediately, but they must be personalized at least 24 hours before the event. More information, including the personalization deadline, can be found in the confirmation email of your order.

Have you lost your tickets? You can request them again here

Do I need to bring identification to the event?

Yes, you are legally required to provide identification. At the entrance, security may ask for an ID to verify that the name matches the personalized ticket. Please note that a copy of your ID is not valid. Entry to the event may be denied if the name on the ticket does not match the ID, and the value of the ticket will not be refunded.

I need to change the name on my ticket, what can I do?

It is possible to change the name on a ticket (for example, if you want to invite someone else to the event). To discourage unauthorised sellers, a small charge applies. For this reason, it is important to enter your details correctly the first time.

If you have already personalised your tickets but want to change the name, you can do this via Ticket Transfer. You will need the ticket’s barcode and the email address used to order the ticket. You can change the name on your ticket via this link.

Please note: By transferring the ticket, a new order will be created for the new owner. The original ticket will be automatically canceled and will no longer appear in your orders.

I can’t attend, can I sell my ticket(s) on TicketSwap?

Yes, selling your tickets is possible via the confirmation email you received from Paylogic. In the email, click the “Manage order” button to see an overview of your purchased tickets. To sell a ticket on TicketSwap, click “More actions” and then “Sell on TicketSwap.”
